---
Assessment (Claude, ~90M-token checkpoint, step ~22,100, eval loss ~4.37):
No numeric answer attempted, not even a wrong one. The response collapses within the first few characters into an extremely long run of a single repeated symbol ("="), with no digits, no arithmetic notation, no words — the most severe and immediate collapse of all seven samples.
Verdict: total failure, as expected at this token count (arithmetic is a hard, late-emerging capability even for much larger models). The instant, single-character nature of this collapse (vs. the multi-token loops in coding/following-instructions/knowledge) suggests the prompt's "17 x 24?" left the model with essentially no confident next-token distribution at all. See training-journal.txt for the pattern across categories.
